P.name: Prowl
P.title: Template:Data Nidalee/Prowl
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Prowl|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Nidalee
|skill        = I
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate - Prowl:}} While in {{tip|brush}}, {{ci|Nidalee}} becomes {{tip|ghosted}} and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a short time, increased when facing a nearby enemy {{tip|champion}}. These bonuses briefly persist after exiting brush.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Innate - Hunt:}} Hitting nearby {{tip|monsters}} or enemy champions with ''{{ai|Javelin Toss|Nidalee}}'' or ''{{ai|Bushwhack|Nidalee}}'' will apply a ''Hunted'' mark and {{tip|true sight|reveal}} them for a few seconds. During this time, '''Nidalee''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, increased when facing a ''Hunted'' target.
|blurb3       = '''Nidalee's''' first use of ''{{ai|Takedown|Nidalee}}'' and ''{{ai|Pounce|Nidalee}}'' against ''Hunted'' targets are empowered.
|icon         = Prowl.png
|description  = {{sbc|Innate - Prowl:}} While in {{tip|brush}}, '''Nidalee''' gains {{tip|ghosting}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, increased to {{as|30%|ms}} while facing a {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champion}} within 1400 range. The bonuses persist for 2 seconds after leaving brush.
|description2 = {{sbc|Innate - Hunt:}} Hitting enemy {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|monsters}} with ''{{ai|Javelin Toss|Nidalee}}'' or ''{{ai|Bushwhack|Nidalee}}'' applies a ''Hunted'' mark to the target for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}} as well as grant {{tip|sight}} of a 300-unit radius around them. If '''Nidalee''' is nearby when the target is hit, she gains {{tip|ghosting}} and {{as|10% '''bonus''' movement speed}} for 4 seconds, increased to {{as|30%|ms}} while she is facing a ''Hunted'' target. Additionally, the first cast of both ''{{ai|Takedown|Nidalee}}'' and ''{{ai|Pounce|Nidalee}}'' against a ''Hunted'' target is enhanced.
|description3 = The {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} from ''Prowl'' and ''Hunt'' can stack, but cannot exceed {{as|30%|ms}}.
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Enemies, Self
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tt|3000|Range for granting Nidalee Hunt's movement speed bonus}}|{{tt|5500|Hunt increased bonus movement speed range when facing Hunted targets}}}}
|damagetype   = 
|spelleffects = 
|notes        = 
}}

Q.name: Javelin Toss
Q.title: Template:Data Nidalee/Javelin Toss
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Javelin Toss|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Nidalee
|skill        = Q
|icon         = Javelin Toss.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Nidalee}} hurls a javelin in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit based on distance travelled.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' hurls a javelin in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit, increased by {{pp|type=distance traveled|key=%|0 to 225 for 6|525 to 1300}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|70 to 150}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|70*3.25 to 150*3.25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*3.25}}% AP)}}}}
|cooldown     = 6
|cost         = {{ap|50 to 70}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|costtype     = Mana
|range        = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 1500
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} 80
|speed        = 1300
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spelleffects = Single target
|spellshield  = True
|projectile   = True
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
{{Effect at cast time start}}
* The damage amplification is based on the distance from '''Nidalee's''' location at the ''end'' of the cast time to the struck target's center at the time of collision.
** The damage increase is very slightly higher than the spear's travel distance due to edge range behaviour of collisions and the distance being measured as the radius from the picked "origin" location at the end of the cast time, rather than just along the vector of the cast.
** The damage increase does not have distinct thresholds based on the distance the spear travelled.
** Picking Nidalee's location at the end of the cast time as the "origin" for the damage calculation may be unintended.{{bug|2}}
}}

Q.name: Takedown
Q.title: Template:Data Nidalee/Takedown
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1|Ability data}}}|Takedown|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}} |champion = Nidalee |skill = Q |icon = Takedown.png |blurb = {{sbc|Active:}} {{cis|Nidalee}} next {{tip|basic attack}} within some time will gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|magic damage}} based on the {{as|target's '''missing''' health}}. |blurb2 = {{sbc|{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunted}} Bonus:}} A ''Hunted'' target hit will take {{ccs|increased damage|magic}}. |description = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' empowers her next {{tip|basic attack}} within 10 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|75 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''modified''' magic damage}} that is increased by an amount for every {{as|1% of the target's '''missing''' health}}.

''Takedown'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Nidalee|crit_base}}|100|base = 100}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}. |leveling = {{sbc|''{{ai|Takedown|Nidalee}}'' scales with ''{{ais|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee}}'' rank}} {{st|Minimum Magic Damage|{{ap|5 to 80 4}} {{as|(+ 75% AD)}} {{as|(+ 40% AP)}}|Maximum Magic Damage|{{ap|(5 to 80)*(1+(1 to 1.75)) 4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|75*(1+1) to 75*(1+1.75) 4}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*(1+1) to 40*(1+1.75) 4}}% AP)}}}} {{st|Increased Damage Modifier|{{ap|1 to 1.75 4}}%|Maximum Increased Damage|{{ap|1*100 to 1.75*100 4}}%}} |description2 = {{sbc|''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunt}}'' Bonus:}} Hitting a ''Hunted'' target {{ccs|increases|magic}} ''Takedown's'' damage by 30%. |leveling2 = {{st|''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee}}''-Enhanced Minimum Damage|{{ap|5*1.3 to 80*1.3 4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|75*1.3}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*1.3}}% AP)}}|''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee}}''-Enhanced Maximum Damage|{{ap|(5 to 80)*(1+(1 to 1.75))*1.3 4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|75*(1+1)*1.3 to 75*(1+1.75)*1.3 4}}% AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*(1+1)*1.3 to 40*(1+1.75)*1.3 4}}% AP)}}}} |description3 = ''Takedown {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Nidalee's''' basic attack timer. Other damage converted to {{as|magic damage}} by Takedown are not increased by Takedown's respective effects. '''Nidalee''' loses Takedown's empowered attack immediately when she switches to {{ai|Aspect of the Cougar|Nidalee|Human Form}}.'' |cooldown = 6 |cdstart = post-effect |cast time = none |targeting = Auto |affects = Self, Enemies |damagetype = Magic |spelleffects = Special |spellshield = True |grounded = |knockdown = |parry = unknown |notes = * ''Takedown's'' attack deals {{tip|basic damage}}, but also triggers spell effects by also being tagged as {{tip|spell damage}}. * ''Takedown's'' damage is not affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers, but the basic attack can still critically strike and the '''bonus''' damage from the critical strike is converted to {{as|magic damage}}. ** ''Takedown's'' damage modifier does not affect the '''bonus''' damage dealt by the critical strike. * ''Takedown'' converts the '''bonus''' damage dealt by {{tip|Spellblade}} to {{as|magic damage}} from {{as|physical|physical damage}}, but does not apply its damage modifier to the effect. * ''Takedown's'' damage will apply {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}}. * ''Takedown's'' damage modifier does not apply against structures; the minimum damage is always applied. * {{pending for test}} - Parry interactions ({{tip|dodge}}, {{tip|block}} and {{tip|blind}}). }}

R.name: Aspect of the Cougar
R.title: Template:Data Nidalee/Aspect of the Cougar
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Aspect of the Cougar|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Nidalee
|skill        = R
|icon         = false
|blurbicon= Aspect of the Cougar.png
|cooldown     = 3
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Nidalee}} switches between her '''Human Form''' and '''Cougar Form'''.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|[[File:Aspect of the Cougar.png|20px|link=|border]] Cougar Form:}} '''Nidalee''' transforms into a cougar, gaining {{tip|melee}} attacks and access to her cougar abilities.
|blurb3      = {{sbc|[[File:Aspect of the Cougar 2.png|20px|link=|border]] Human Form:}} '''Nidalee''' transforms into a human, gaining {{tip|ranged}} attacks and access to her human abilities. While in '''Human Form''', applying a ''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunted}}'' mark will {{sti|cdr|reset}} ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' cooldown.
|blurb4      = '''Nidalee''' begins with one rank in ''Aspect of the Cougar''. '''Cougar Form's''' abilities scale based on ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' rank.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Nidalee''' switches between her {{sbc|Human Form}} and {{sbc|Cougar Form}}.
|icon2         = Aspect of the Cougar.png
|description2= {{sbc|Cougar Form:}} '''Nidalee''' transforms into a cougar, gaining {{tip|melee}} attacks with {{sti|range|125 range}} and access to her cougar abilities.
|icon3        = Aspect of the Cougar 2.png
|description3 = {{sbc|Human Form:}} '''Nidalee''' transforms into a human, gaining {{tip|ranged}} attacks with {{sti|range|525 range}} and access to her human abilities. While in this form, applying a ''{{ai|Prowl|Nidalee|Hunted}}'' mark will reset ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
|description5 = '''Nidalee''' begins with one rank in ''Aspect of the Cougar'' and can increase it at levels 6, 11, and 16. {{sbc|Cougar Form's}} abilities scale based on ''Aspect of the Cougar's'' rank.
|cast time = none
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = 
|notes        =
*Transformations do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
}}
